title: Benchmarking_Fast_Domain_Adaptation_for_Unsupervised_Speech_Units
abstract: arXiv:2608.26992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representation learning has attracted great atten- tion and managed to reach good performances as a pretraining method for downstream tasks or as a first step towards unsu- pervised speech modeling. Yet, little is known about how such methods deal with out-of-domain speech and how could they be adapted in a few shot to new domains. This is important especially for accented speech where one observes a long tail of accents that diverge from the standard ones. We introduce ABX- Accent, a benchmark based on the AESRC dataset that features 10 different accents of English. It includes a small (< 10 hours) unlabelled training set in each of the accents and adaptations of the Zero Resources Challenge ABX evaluation metrics to each of the accents. We illustrate this benchmark with a baseline model that uses adaptive domain normalization to fine tune a pretrained Contrastive Predictive Coding model on the accents. translated_title: 面向无监督语音单元的快速域适应基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26992v1 公告类型：新 摘要：表示学习作为下游任务的预训练方法或迈向无监督语音建模的第一步，已引起广泛关注并取得良好性能。然而，关于这些方法如何处理域外语音以及如何在少量样本下适应新域，我们知之甚少。这对于口音语音尤为重要，因为存在大量偏离标准口音的长尾口音分布。我们引入了ABX-Accent，这是一个基于AESRC数据集的基准，涵盖10种不同的英语口音。它包含每种口音的小型（<10小时）未标注训练集，并调整了零资源挑战ABX评估指标以适应每种口音。我们通过一个基线模型展示了该基准，该模型使用自适应域归一化来微调预训练的对比预测编码模型以适应口音。该方法首先在此基准上开发。
tldr: 本文提出了ABX-Accent基准，用于评估无监督语音表示在多种口音上的快速域适应能力，并展示了基于自适应域归一化的基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the ABX-Accent benchmark to evaluate fast domain adaptation of unsupervised speech representations across multiple accents, and demonstrates a baseline method using adaptive domain normalization.
